channel.title: Humanoid News
channel.description: Independent, answer-first news on humanoid robots: Tesla Optimus, Figure, Agility, Boston Dynamics, Unitree, 1X and more.

item.title: Agility moves Digit 5 onto NVIDIA IGX Thor and expands in Pittsburgh
item.description: Agility Robotics says Digit 5 will run on NVIDIA IGX Thor compute, and that it is opening a 50,000 sq ft Pittsburgh hub and holds over $300M in multi-year Digit 5 orders.

item.title: AGCO plans a Digit humanoid pilot at its Hesston, Kansas, factory from 2027
item.description: Farm-machinery maker AGCO and Agility Robotics say they have signed a commercial agreement to pilot the Digit humanoid at AGCO's Hesston, Kansas, plant, starting in 2027.

item.title: Figure says Figure 04 is in design lock and teases Helix 3.0 in a public all-hands
item.description: In a published all-hands recording, Figure CEO Brett Adcock said Figure 04 has reached design lock, its Index app has 37.5 million human videos, and previewed Helix 3.0.

item.title: Alibaba's Amap team releases λ0, a humanoid model trained largely on human video
item.description: Researchers at Alibaba's Amap and Token Hub released λ0, a whole-body humanoid model trained on a 500-hour human video dataset; they report 62.5% success on four real-world tasks with a Unitree G1.

item.title: XPENG shows IRON switching between handshakes, fist bumps and high fives
item.description: A new XPENG video shows its IRON humanoid adapting as a tester changes gestures mid-movement; XPENG credits its VLA 2.0 model, which it says re-evaluates the scene every 0.2 seconds.

item.title: NEURA unveils a lighter 4NE1 Gen 4 humanoid as the TUM RoboGym opens near Munich
item.description: NEURA says its 4NE1 Gen 4 humanoid is 20% lighter and being readied for series production; it launched at the new TUM RoboGym near Munich Airport.

item.title: Generative Bionics plans a 5,000 m² humanoid training "data factory" in Italy with AMD
item.description: Generative Bionics says it will build a three-site Physical AI Data Factory network, starting with a 5,000 m² Italian hub due by Q4 2027, using AMD compute.

item.title: AiMOGA opens worldwide pre-orders for Mobo, a 0.9 m family companion humanoid
item.description: AiMOGA Robotics says it has opened global pre-orders for Mobo, a 0.9-metre home companion humanoid with 22 degrees of freedom; no price was announced.

item.title: Chinese humanoid makers seek factory and cafe trials in South Korea
item.description: UBTech, Anyverse Dynamics and other Chinese firms are pursuing trials in South Korea as Seoul proposes 3.1 trillion won for physical AI, Korea Times reports.

item.title: Why UCLA's PhoneBot, a small humanoid run by a smartphone, is getting attention
item.description: UCLA's open-source PhoneBot uses an Android phone for sensing and computing in a 48 cm biped that its researchers say costs about $400 without the phone.

item.title: Unitree says it is building "Rehearsal", a self-improving loop for robot software
item.description: Unitree's Wang Xingxing said on 22 Oct 2026 the firm is developing "Rehearsal", a loop for robots to write code, test it in simulation and improve (SCMP).

item.title: Why Unitree's H2-X "Guardian" video is getting attention
item.description: Unitree's H2-X teaser shows martial arts and staged rescue scenes; outlets note it released few specifications and it is unclear how autonomous the demos were.

item.title: Why Figure's nine-day Figure 03 treadmill test is getting attention
item.description: Figure CEO Brett Adcock said a Figure 03 robot walked 348 miles over nine days on a treadmill; outlets note power and interruption details are unclear.

item.title: Tesla targets end of 2027 for external Optimus deliveries, Musk says
item.description: Elon Musk said on Tesla's Q3 2026 earnings call that Tesla expects to start delivering Optimus robots to outside customers around the end of 2027, according to Electrek.

item.title: Danish grocer Føtex pilots Unitree humanoids for overnight restocking
item.description: Føtex, part of Salling Group, has started a multi-year pilot with HIVE Robots to train humanoid robots to restock shelves after closing time, ESM Magazine reports.

item.title: Berkeley's SuperMimic trains a humanoid motion controller in three hours on one GPU, authors report
item.description: UC Berkeley researchers report that SuperMimic matched a baseline humanoid motion tracker that trained for seven days on 128 GPUs, using three hours on one GPU.

item.title: NVIDIA expands Isaac robotics platform as Agile Robots unveils Agile ONE SN humanoid
item.description: At GTC Berlin on 21 October 2026, NVIDIA announced additions to its Isaac robotics platform and Agile Robots announced the Agile ONE SN reference humanoid, according to NVIDIA.

item.title: Schaeffler opens Taicang factory where humanoids help build parts for humanoids
item.description: Schaeffler says its new Taicang, China factory uses six humanoids to assemble joint modules, including actuators, for other humanoid robots.

item.title: Eka Robotics announces $150M Series A for force-sensing robot manipulation
item.description: Eka Robotics said on 20 October 2026 it raised a $150 million Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz and F-Prime; SiliconANGLE reports a $1.45 billion valuation.

item.title: China expects over 100,000 humanoid robots built in 2026 as first national standards approach
item.description: A Chinese ministry official said China expects over 100,000 humanoids built in 2026, per China's SCIO; first national standards apply from April 2027.

item.title: South Korea grants safety-rule exemption for 20 Robros humanoids in factory pilot
item.description: A Korean regulatory-sandbox committee granted Robros an exemption so 20 of its humanoid robots can work near people at four companies' sites, Seoul Economic Daily reports.

item.title: Minerva Humanoids says it raised about $10M pre-seed led by General Catalyst
item.description: San Francisco start-up Minerva Humanoids said on 6 October 2026 it has raised about $10 million in pre-seed funding led by General Catalyst, according to its press release.
